note: The runner MUST read every parameter from this file. Per-model configs are not consulted. Any parameter under `held_constant` differing between arms is a confound.

held_constant.convergence: normalized output hash equals previous iteration (collapse whitespace, strip comments before hashing)
held_constant.page_slice: the files listed in sample/sites.csv `slice_files` for that site: index.html + form_page + its stylesheet(s). Do NOT hardcode css/styles.css - PORT-03 and PORT-04 use assets/styles.css.

truncation_guard.on_failure: mark status=failed; never keep a truncated output

held_constant.output_contract: one JSON evaluation object, then the complete rewritten files; no commentary, no markdown fences; all relative paths preserved
held_constant.quantization_note: Quantization differs by arm and is recorded per arm, not held constant - it is a property of the arm. Expect elevated truncation/malformed-output rates from Q4 arms; the truncation guard catches these and per-arm failure counts are a reportable result.

A5.concurrency: MEASURE FIRST - 1 GPU / 8 cores per session; compare completed calls/min at 4 vs 8 parallel
A5.serving: self-hosted, SECOND ARC session (own GPU, runs in parallel with A6)
A5.selection_note: Chosen over the R1 distills because R1-Distill-Qwen-* and R1-0528-Qwen3-8B are distills into Qwen and would collide with A6's family, and because R1-family models emit reasoning blocks that cannot be disabled, violating held_constant.reasoning.
A5.throughput_note: 720 calls at full depth. Depth-nest to 400 if projected runtime exceeds ~8h.
A5.fallback: depth-nest: depth 1 on all 60 + depth 3 on a stratified 20 = 400 calls
A5.verify_before_use: confirm context >= ~20K in and >= ~15K out; if it cannot emit 15K tokens of coherent HTML, reconsider R1-Distill-Qwen-32B and record the A5/A6 base-family collision as a limitation

A6.concurrency: MEASURE FIRST - test 8 before accepting 4; old max_concurrent_builds=4 was sized for 28-turn builds, not single-turn repair
A6.throughput_note: 720 calls at full depth. Fits a 6h window only if latency <= 2min at 4 concurrent, or <= 4min at 8. Run 5 real repair calls before committing to full depth.
A6.fallback: depth-nest: depth 1 on all 60 + depth 3 on a stratified 20 = 400 calls

A7.concurrency: MEASURE FIRST - same test as A5/A6: completed calls/min at 4 vs 8 parallel
A7.serving: self-hosted, THIRD ARC session (own GPU, runs in parallel with A5 and A6)
A7.selection_note: Added because the DeepSeek (A5) queue was too slow. GLM is a distinct base family from deepseek and qwen, so it adds no family collision. Reasoning must be disabled to honour held_constant.reasoning.
A7.throughput_note: 720 calls at full depth. Measure 5 real repair calls before committing.
A7.fallback: depth-nest: depth 1 on all 60 + depth 3 on a stratified 20 = 400 calls

judge.neutrality: Gemini is not a repair arm and was not a generator group (claude / codex / open-source), so it has no self-preference on any arm.
judge.task: rank V1-V4 per question, 14 questions, ties permitted

keys.source: environment variables only; never written to this repository or to run evidence
keys.note: A6_API_KEY issued 2026-11-19 (VT ARC session 22336989). Export in the shell; never commit.

schedule_risk.measure_before_running: 5 real repair calls per self-hosted arm; compute calls * latency / concurrency
schedule_risk.parallelism: A5, A6 and A7 occupy separate ARC sessions with separate GPUs, so they run concurrently; generation wall clock is max(A5, A6, A7, frontier~4h), not the sum.
schedule_risk.start_order: Launch A5, A6 and A7 first - they are the long pole by 2-3x. A1-A4 finish in ~4h whenever started.
schedule_risk.session_hygiene: Both ARC sessions auto-terminate after 1h idle (already observed in models.json). Keepalive ping every ~20 min on each while any other arm is running. Delete both sessions when the run completes.
schedule_risk.decision_rule: After 5 real repair calls per self-hosted arm: calls * latency / concurrency. Over ~8h projected -> depth-nest that arm only; the two arms are independent.
